title: PolicyDecision
description: Canonical wire shape for a Policy.evaluate(action) decision (per A3/A6). The Action it decides over, and the ApprovalRequest/ApprovalDecision it may produce, share the same camelCase form. Python dataclasses live in policy.py (added in Phase 3); these schemas are the SSOT consumed by conformance vectors in Stages 2-3.

kind.description: Action kind this decision applies to (nullable): command, file_write, diff_apply, tool, or an unknown kind.

approvalId.description: Present only when effect=require_approval: id of the surfaced ApprovalRequest.
